title: Wheatstone bridge balance
description: Balance a Wheatstone bridge fed by 'V1 vin 0 DC 10' (required exactly). Two arms are fixed and must appear exactly as 'R1 vin a 1k' and 'R3 vin b 2.2k'. Choose R2 (from 'a' to ground) and R4 (from 'b' to ground) so that the bridge is balanced to within 5mV (|V(a)-V(b)| <= 0.005V) and V(a) is between 4V and 6V. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
